title: Skill default overrides an explicit CPU scoring instruction

source.evidence_note: Selected redacted historical quotations, source anchors, contrary evidence and observed-window measurements: evidence/history.md. Original records remain private; owner review pending.

horizon.intervening_work: See private evidence record. Reduced task keeps inspection then decision, omitting unrelated work.
horizon.mechanism: Observed error; long-history causation unestablished. The reduction tests the decision, not incidence or temporal causation.

failure.expected_behavior: Apply the latest user instruction in fixture.json. This is a local decision mock with no live host or scheduler. Write decision.json with cancel_ids, scoring_location, and action.
failure.observed_behavior: After identifying scoring as CPU-only, the user explicitly asked to cancel queued scoring jobs and score on the login node. The agent canceled both but refused scoring solely because the invoked skill prohibited login-node evaluation. Later in the same session it performed CPU scoring on the login node under the persisting instruction.

commands.run_agent: Trusted evaluator presents task/01-inspect.md, then task/02-decide.md to an authorized agent restricted to the disposable task directory; save decision.json. No model runner bundled or run.
